description: List the image frames (Bildrahmen) of the document with their alternative text (Alternativtext) for an accessible PDF – also anchored and grouped ones – and groups that carry their own alternative text. Each entry: frame_id, kind (image | group), page, on_parent, anchored, in_group, file_name, alt_source (custom, xmp_title, xmp_description, xmp_headline, xmp_alt_text, xmp_extended_description, xmp_other, structure, decorative), alt_text (resolved; "" = none, null = not readable here), xmp_property, actual_text_source, actual_text, tag (from_structure, artifact, based_on_object), covered_by_group_id and problem: missing, decorative_not_artifact (exported as a figure without text), hidden_by_group (a group with its own alternative text swallows the image), unverified (XMP field not readable), hides_children (group) or null. Parent page images only with include_parent_pages true. Returns items[], count, total, truncated, summary {images, missing, artifacts, hidden_by_group, decorative_not_artifact, unverified, groups_with_alt_text}. Read-only; change them with set_alt_text.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

include_parent_pages.description: Also list images on parent pages (Musterseiten). Default false.

page_range.description: Only these pages, by printed page name, e.g. "1-4" or "2, 5". Default all.

name: list_alt_texts
title: List alternative texts
